text:
jordan: FYI vendor posted emergency PDU handshake on eu-central2-edge rack Q3 — scheduled Thu 2026-05-07 01:30-03:30 UTC. They want sequenced PDU soft-cycles to fix flapping under load. Expect transient netlink drops and occasional host reboots. Goal: no service interruption for core routes, but prep retries/fallbacks.

maria: Affected pool(s)? Any Dedicated instances pinned?

jordan: Affected: eu-central2-edge-gpu-pool-main (hosts q3-01..q3-10). Dedicated: tenant-ai-labs pinned on q3-06. We'll attempt live-migrate, then graceful drain if LM fails.

lee: Proposal: 1) bump pool min to 3 for headroom, 2) pre-warm 3 warm-nodes in same AZ, 3) do soft-cycles one chassis at a time with 8m gap. Quick run snippet: ```for h in q3-01..q3-10; do rctl maintenance add $h && infractl drain $h --grace 90 && vendorctl pdu-softcycle $h && sleep 480; done```

olivia: LM probe now: `./bin/probe-lm --pool eu-central2-edge-gpu-pool-main --quick` — will post summary. Also flagging tenant-ai-labs as SLA sensitive.

ops-bot: Created task INFRA-1310, calendar slot set, automated customer notice scheduled to go 24h before.

maria: Cost note: if we need cross-AZ failover (to eu-central2-standby or eu-west2), estimate +18% on serving bill for 2h. Ops chargeback to infra budget? @henry

henry: Confirmed we have a monthly burst allowance; please log estimated delta for post-op charge.

olivia: LM probe result: 9/10 hosts pass. q3-06 fails due to NV driver handshake. Recommendation: exclude q3-06 from automatic LM and plan manual patch after vendor cycles. Full logs attached to INFRA-1310.

jordan: OK exclude q3-06. Action list: maria export host->tenant mapping + SLA opt-outs; lee set autoscale min=3 and pre-warm 3 nodes; olivia attach LM logs; henry note budget; I'll draft customer comms. SRE-oncall: be ready to abort if 5xx >1.5x baseline for 10m.

sre-oncall: I'll monitor health dashboards and page if sustained errors. If route embedding-search sees latency regressions, we'll divert traffic to standby and then open a post-mortem.

maria: Uploaded mapping with opt-outs: tenant-payroll and tenant-medical excluded. Also adding short customer note draft: "We will perform vendor-scheduled PDU soft-cycles on Thu 2026-05-07 01:30-03:30 UTC in eu-central2-edge Q3. We expect brief retries; no action required. Contact support for dedicated SLA exceptions."

jordan: Thanks. Final runbook bullets in INFRA-1310: mark-maint, pre-warm, LM probe, sequential soft-cycle w/8m gap, keep autoscale min for 3h after, monitor per-route 95p and 5xx, abort threshold 1.5x 5xx for 10m. We'll run this during quiet window. Any objections?

henry: No objections. Chargeback recorded.

jordan: Closing loop. Will post final comms 24h prior and pin runbook to the ticket. :white_check_mark:
